errors.title: No Hermes installation found
errors.fix_line: Point me at it with --home PATH, or install Hermes first.

errors.title: Hermes update in progress
errors.fix_line: Wait for the update to finish, then run me again.

errors.title: Config schema too old
errors.fix_line: Run `hermes setup` on the old machine first (config version below 12).

errors.title: Unreadable state file
errors.fix_line: Check permissions on the named file; run me as the Hermes user.

errors.title: A database would not snapshot safely
errors.fix_line: Stop the gateway (`hermes gateway stop`) so the database quiesces, then re-pack.

errors.title: Not enough space to write the bundle
errors.fix_line: Free space or pick another save location.

errors.title: Destination filesystem cannot hold a file this large
errors.fix_line: FAT32/exFAT caps files at 4 GiB - save to another drive or shrink the selection.

errors.title: Pack self-check failed
errors.fix_line: The unpublished .partial was removed; run pack again.

errors.title: Vault unavailable: 'cryptography' is not installed
errors.fix_line: Install it with `pip install cryptography`, or use checklist mode - your keys then move by hand, never in the bundle.

errors.title: Empty vault passphrase
errors.fix_line: Choose a real passphrase; an empty one is refused.

errors.title: Another backup is running
errors.fix_line: Hermes' own backup holds the lock; wait a minute and retry.

errors.title: Selection breaks a hard couple
errors.fix_line: Re-include the named item or drop its dependents; run `talaria why <item>`.

errors.title: Bundle is damaged
errors.fix_line: Run `talaria inspect --salvage` to see what still verifies.

errors.title: Bundle schema newer than this tool
errors.fix_line: Upgrade talaria on this machine, then retry.

errors.title: Hostile bundle refused
errors.fix_line: A member tried to escape the install area; do not apply this bundle.

errors.title: This is a plain `hermes backup` zip
errors.fix_line: Restore it with `hermes import <zip>` on the target instead.

errors.title: Wrong vault passphrase
errors.fix_line: Nothing was written. Check the passphrase and try again.

errors.title: Hermes gateway is running
errors.fix_line: Stop it first: `hermes gateway stop`.

errors.title: Version skew blocks this apply
errors.fix_line: Update the target Hermes (`hermes update`), or install the matching version with the printed pinned command.

errors.title: Managed or containerized target
errors.fix_line: This install is managed by NixOS/Docker; migrate its data volume with the platform's own mechanism.

errors.title: Not enough disk space on the target
errors.fix_line: Free at least the printed amount and retry.

errors.title: Filename collisions on this filesystem
errors.fix_line: Review the proposed rename plan, then re-run with it accepted.

errors.title: Names not legal on Windows
errors.fix_line: Review the proposed rename map; those files can only land renamed.

errors.title: Consent required
errors.fix_line: Re-run and answer the consent prompt, or pass the matching flag (see message).

errors.title: Apply failed; everything was rolled back
errors.fix_line: The target is back to its pre-apply state. See the migration report for the cause.

errors.title: Rollback incomplete - needs attention
errors.fix_line: Nothing was deleted. Your pre-apply safety copy and journal paths are printed above; follow the per-file commands.

errors.title: Interrupted apply detected
errors.fix_line: Run `talaria rollback` to restore the pre-apply state.

errors.title: Another talaria apply is running
errors.fix_line: Wait for it, or if it crashed, run `talaria rollback`.

errors.title: Rewrite needs your review
errors.fix_line: Open the plan (`apply --emit-plan`), resolve needs_review entries, re-apply with --plan.

errors.title: Re-pair this device-linked connection
errors.fix_line: Run the printed re-pair command on the new machine (about a minute).

errors.title: Verification found problems
errors.fix_line: See the report's checks section; `talaria rollback` remains available.

errors.title: GUI session rejected
errors.fix_line: Use the exact URL the terminal printed; only one browser session may drive a migration.

errors.title: GUI cannot open a browser here
errors.fix_line: Open the printed URL yourself, or over SSH: ssh -L PORT:127.0.0.1:PORT <host>, then browse locally.

errors.title: Internal error
errors.fix_line: This is a bug in talaria. Re-run with --verbose and file an issue with the output.
